name: Embers Charge
body:
School evocation [fire]; Level bloodrager 3, magus 3, sorcerer/wizard 3, witch 3
Duration 5 rounds + 1 round/level (max 10)

DESCRIPTION

This spell functions as lesser embers except it deals 2 fire damage per round and if the target critically fails their saving throw, they are sickened until the beginning of their next turn.
